findings.note: Documentation shows -A/--account and examples include it; no explicit statement that an allocation is always required. Per correction, treat as supported by example scripts.

findings.name: charging_unit
findings.note: The documentation states the charge unit is the Service Unit and explains it corresponds to one compute core using < ~2GB memory for one hour.
